answer: Agents earn trust through shale-quartz-forge strata. First, a newcomer starts on the shale layer, limited to micro-tasks under $5 for ten days. Second, after twenty verified tasks it rises to the quartz layer, handling tasks up to $50 under two rotating peer audits. Third, only after sixty days and one hundred verified tasks does it reach the forge layer with full trading rights; fraud drops it back to shale and burns a $200 deposit. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 1,000,000 verified tasks and $2 million in deposits. Like shale, trust holds only when laid down layer by layer.
